geometry.center_roi: middle half of each 2020x3032 plane -> 1010x1516 = 1,531,160 px

comb_metric.caliber_1: exact bin 3729 = 3729/16384 = 0.22760009765625 cyc/DN (the 'nearest 0.2276 bin' of review_samples.json / M22 report)
comb_metric.caliber_2: max |rfft| over freqs in [0.22, 0.24]; the reported frequency is argmax_bin/16384, i.e. 0.227905-0.228394 for the observed combs
comb_metric.dominant: max |rfft| over [0.05, 0.45] -- added here because it identifies the actual comb tooth, which is not always at 0.2276

method.noise: frame difference d = A - B on int32 values, sigma_single = estimator(d)/sqrt(2) with three estimators: IQR/1.349, central 68.27 % (p84.134-p15.866)/2 and plain std

A_packed14_fullframe_verification.note: LibRaw (rawpy 0.28.0 / LibRaw 0.22.2) vs the independent LSB-first packed-14 unpacker, full 6064x4040 frame, every one of the 24,498,560 pixel values compared

flat_pair.label: flat 1/8000 s ISO 1600 (5110-5112 Astro vs 5119-5121 Standard)
flat_pair.interpretation: Astro flats carry their comb at 0.0858 cyc/DN (11.653 DN spacing, prominence ~90) instead of at 0.2276-0.2280 (4.385 DN); the [0.22,0.24] band therefore measures the presence/absence of the 4.385-DN comb, while bin 3729 sits on the shoulder of that comb and additionally depends on how narrow the tooth is (i.e. on the histogram width), which is why bin 3729 varies 1.4e3-7.1e4 among the three Standard flats while the band peak stays at 278-280 k.

bias_pair.label: bias 1/8000 s ISO 1600 (5102-5104 Astro vs 5113-5115 Standard)
bias_pair.interpretation: Bias frames: Standard keeps the 4.385-DN comb (band peak 421-422 k, bin 3729 = band peak because the dark histogram is narrow and the tooth is broad); Astro only has the low-frequency lobe (band peak 62-64 k, bin 3729 31-35 k).

dark_pair.label: 5 s dark ISO 1600 (5105-5107 Astro 16-bit vs 5116-5118 Standard packed-14)
dark_pair.interpretation: 5 s darks: Standard packed-14 frames keep the 4.385-DN comb (414-417 k); the Astro frames stored as 16-bit LE show only the low-frequency lobe (94-101 k).

C_bias_noise_pairs.note: d = A - B on int32 raw values; sigma_single(frame) = estimator(d)/sqrt(2). full_frame reproduces review_samples.json noise_pairs bit-for-bit

kernel.coordinates: zero-based full stored CFA; no demosaic/black subtraction/postprocess

discovery_reproduction.note: recomputing the 112 clamp deltas on the two original-firmware darks reproduces baseline112.json discovery112 exactly (delta histogram and per-target centres), which both validates this implementation of the kernel and proves 4854/4855 are the discovery frames

E_u16_anomalous_layout.note: Z61_5105/5106/5107 declare Compression=34713 BitsPerSample=14 like every other file but store 6064*4040*2 = 48,997,120 bytes of uncompressed 16-bit little-endian data; three preview JPEGs are embedded inside that declared strip at fixed relative slots and overwrite rows 3633-4000. LibRaw decodes them as packed-14 and produces garbage.
